items.html: Accordingly, as soon as he emerged, he immediately began to sort out the aspect of these kings, so as to make an aspect of Nukva for himself, which is called Ban of the Heh's. Therefore it is said of him, “And Hadar reigned in his place, and his wife's name was Mehetabel.” As it is written in the Zohar, that until now male and female were not mentioned at all, only now; and therefore all was sustained, for now there was male and female as is fitting. And this is mentioned in the Idra Raba.
